reason: The executed main requires a named worker, default-worker send/receive, and propagation of a worker panic through wait. Named workers and worker messaging are not covered by the subset's positive lists; support for wait and panic alone does not establish these behaviors. This decisive unsupported concurrency construct makes the whole case a feature.

Future cancellation via f1.cancel() elsewhere in the file is outside the langlib method allowlist.
test_design_notes: main calls receiveFromDefaultWithPanicAfterReceiveInWorker; its @panic marker is on the error construction inside the worker, while the panic is subsequently observed through wait.
The file retains many unrelated worker, cancellation, lambda, query and lock scenarios; whole-file assessment includes this mixed scope. No @args or @output markers are present.
